sql: select exists (select 1 from brandbase.ideas r where r.id = :id and r.post_id = :postId) or not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(:channels::jsonb, '[]')) c, brandbase.brands b where b.id = :brand and (not c = any (b.linked) or not c = any (brandbase.allowed_channels(i.format)))) as ok from brandbase.ideas i where i.id = :id
message: an account is not linked to this brand, or the format cannot go there
